title: Build AlphaGo from Scratch
blurb: Rebuild the AlphaGo Zero loop piece by piece in NumPy: Go rules on small boards, a residual policy-value network, PUCT tree search, and the targets and updates that turn self-play into training data. Every search exercise is fully deterministic, so you can check your tree statistics number for number.
prereq: You should be fluent with Python and NumPy arrays and know what a convolution, a softmax and gradient descent do; no prior knowledge of Go is needed.
next: Next, work through the reinforcement learning problems on value functions and policy gradients to see how search-based training relates to model-free methods.
